ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, student-faculty ratio, fall 2024)

stats.notes: Residency split from the Common Data Set (fall 2025): 4 applicants and admits of unknown residency are not included in the in-state, out-of-state or international columns. Undergraduate enrollment is 3,991 and nonresident undergraduates number 197 (the Common Data Set's 'Total Undergraduates' figures, fall 2025). The student-faculty ratio (19:1) is the fall 2024 College Navigator figure, because the ratio in the Common Data Set could not be read. No waiting list, no early decision or early action. Only 38% of enrollees reported a high school GPA, so the GPA figures describe a minority.

cds_test_policy.notes: Test policy: 'The university is test-optional. If the student submits SAT or ACT scores, we will consider it for TSI exemption or higher scholarship.'

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, on-campus; it labels this block 2026-2027): non-resident tuition equals out-of-state tuition, $18,727 for 30 credits. Its estimated on-campus expenses also list transportation $1,778 and other expenses $1,872. Certain programs carry additional course fees. College Navigator (2024-25) showed out-of-state total cost of attendance $40,840 on campus
